name: Chapiter
overview: The term 'chapiter' refers to the decorative head of a pillar, as detailed in the construction of the temple and its furnishings. Scripture describes these chapiters as richly adorned elements, crafted from materials like gold and molten brass, standing prominently atop the pillars with intricate designs including lily work, nets, wreaths, and rows of pomegranates. These embellishments not only highlight the beauty and craftsmanship involved but also signify the importance of the pillars as structural and symbolic supports within the sacred space.
